name: Oak Canna | Zangaroo
description: The Zangaroo strain is a potent hybrid , Zangaroo is known for being a sweet, fruity, and highly aromatic cultivar. It provides a balanced high that usually begins with an uplifting, euphoric head lift before settling into a smooth, relaxed state.
